setting.frameworkPath:
Relative path to the framework folder **(leave empty if the framework is at the root of the workspace)** 

 Example : **`my-project/app/symfony`**
setting.framework: Framework of the project: `auto` detects it from the files of the framework folder. Choose one when the project matches several of them (the DrawMeDatabase output lists the ones found).
setting.framework.auto: Detected from the files of the project
setting.framework.laravel: Laravel: the migrations of database/migrations, after the schema dump of database/schema when there is one
setting.framework.symfony: Symfony: the Doctrine entities of src/Entity
setting.framework.prisma: Prisma: the models of the Prisma schema (prisma/schema.prisma, a schema folder, or the schema of prisma.config.ts)
setting.framework.drizzle: Drizzle: the tables of the Drizzle schema files (the schema of drizzle.config.ts, else src/db/schema.ts...), read without running them
setting.framework.sql: SQL: the SQL migrations replayed in the order of their tool (supabase/migrations, Flyway, dbmate, golang-migrate, goose...) or a dump of the schema (db/structure.sql, schema.sql), read without running them
setting.autoRefresh: Refresh the open diagram while you edit the code of the schema (a migration, an entity, a Prisma schema...), before saving, and when a file is created, deleted or committed.
setting.showGitStatus: Show the git status in the diagram: tables new (not in the last commit), modified, or changed in an editor and not saved yet. Also available in the toolbar of the diagram. The status of each column comes with DrawMeDatabase Pro.
setting.layout.elk: ELK: compact layout with straight, right-angled links (best for large schemas)
setting.layout.dagre: Dagre: the classic Mermaid layout with curved links
setting.layout: How the tables of the diagram are placed. Also available in the toolbar of the diagram.
setting.direction: Direction of the diagram, from the referenced tables to the tables that reference them. Also available in the toolbar of the diagram.
setting.keysOnly: Show only the primary and foreign keys of each table. Also in the options panel of the diagram.
setting.relationLabels: Write the foreign key on each link of the diagram.
setting.language.auto: The language of VS Code (English when it is not translated)
setting.language: Language of the diagram, of the panels of DrawMeDatabase Pro, and of the messages.
setting.theme.auto: The colors of the VS Code theme
setting.theme.light: Light, whatever the VS Code theme
setting.theme.dark: Dark, whatever the VS Code theme
setting.theme: Theme of the diagram and of the panels of DrawMeDatabase Pro.
setting.palette: Colors of the tables and of the links: the ones of the VS Code theme, or a palette (with a light and a dark version).
setting.colors: Custom colors (`#rrggbb`), over the palette: `background`, `header`, `text`, `border`, `line` (links), `accent` (highlight), `gitNew`, `gitModified`, `gitUnsaved`. Easier from the options panel of the diagram.
setting.font: Font of the tables of the diagram.
setting.customFont: Font family used when `DrawMeDatabase.font` is `custom`, for example `Inter`.
setting.fontSize: Size of the text of the diagram, in pixels.
setting.showColumnGitStatus: Show the git status of each column (new, modified, unsaved) in the diagram. A feature of DrawMeDatabase Pro.
welcome.noFolder:
Open the folder of a project to see the schema of its database.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
welcome.loading: Reading the schema of the project…
welcome.noProject:
No supported project was found in this workspace. DrawMeDatabase reads the schema of the database from the code of the project; the frameworks it supports are listed in the DrawMeDatabase output.
If the project is in a subfolder, set its path:
[Set the Framework Folder](command:DMDB.openSettings?%5B%22frameworkPath%22%5D)
[Show Output](command:DMDB.showOutput)
[Refresh](command:DMDB.refreshSchema)
welcome.noTables:
No tables found in the code of the project. The DrawMeDatabase output tells which files were read.
[Show Output](command:DMDB.showOutput)
[Refresh](command:DMDB.refreshSchema)
welcome.error:
The schema could not be read. The details are in the DrawMeDatabase output.
[Show Output](command:DMDB.showOutput)
[Refresh](command:DMDB.refreshSchema)
